page_title: EMP 0-1 NAP | Empoli v Napoli 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' The referee gives a yellow card to Nicolas Haas (Empoli).
90+5' Napoli produce a short pass from the free kick.
90+5' Nicolas Haas (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Rosario Abisso signals a foul. Napoli win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+2' A cross from a corner kick by Napoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+2' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
86' Substitution. Matteo Politano leaves the pitch and is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
86' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Ismael Konate (Empoli) replaces Lorenzo Colombo.
85' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
83' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' The game is interrupted now, Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Substitution. Faustino Anjorin will be replaced by Nicolas Haas (Empoli).
78' Jacopo Fazzini goes off the pitch and Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) comes on.
78' It's time for a substitution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) comes on in place of Saba Goglichidze.
76' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to David Neres (Napoli).
76' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
74' Mattia Viti (Empoli) is penalised for holding. Rosario Abisso signals a set piece.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Grassi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ola Solbakken (Empoli).
70' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
68' Excellent touch by Scott McTominay (Napoli)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
64' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is caught offside!
63' 0 - 1 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
62' Referee Rosario Abisso is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Napoli!
61' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Napoli, he's going to review using VAR.
61' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call. A penalty is awarded to Napoli!
59' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola is replaced by Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
59' The substitution has been made. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) has replaced Romelu Lukaku.
55' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger.
54' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) makes a slide tackle, but referee Rosario Abisso blows for a foul. Empoli are awarded a free kick.
52' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
52' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee signals a corner kick to Empoli.
50' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and it's Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45' The first half of today's match has just finished.
44' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle after Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
43' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
43' A lofted cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Empoli get a corner.
42' The fouls committed statistics – 6:6.
42' The referee blows his whistle as Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
37' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
35' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
33' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

31' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Elia Caprile pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
30' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
30' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli). Rosario Abisso saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Empoli have a free kick.
27' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
26' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
26' A pass by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. Now Napoli have a corner.
23' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
23' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' There's an opportunity for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
21' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Scott McTominay (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
19' Elia Caprile leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli).
19' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Empoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

13' A cross to the edge of the box finds Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with quick shot towards the bottom left corner. Elia Caprile pulls off a good save and the score remains the same. Empoli will take a corner kick.

11' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Elia Caprile denies him.
10' The resulting corner from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is cleared.

10' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
6' Rosario Abisso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Billy Gilmour (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
3' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' The match has just started.
Empoli will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso will supervise the game today.
